title: Bhavnath Fair & Bhavnath Mahadev Temple, Junagadh - A Spiritual Celebration at the Foothills of Girnar
content:
Bhavnath Fair & Bhavnath Mahadev Temple, Junagadh Foothills of Girnar

At the base of the sacred Girnar Hills in Junagadh, lies the revered Bhavnath Mahadev Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva. Every year, this ancient temple becomes the heart of spiritual energy and devotion during the grand Bhavnath Fair (Bhavnath Mela) - one of Gujarat’s most celebrated religious festivals. The fair attracts thousands of devotees, sadhus, and tourists who gather to experience the divine aura, colorful rituals, and traditional music that define this sacred event.

About Bhavnath Mahadev Temple

The Bhavnath Mahadev Temple is an ancient shrine believed to be from the era of the Mahabharata. It houses a self-manifested (Swayambhu) Shiva Lingam, symbolizing eternal divine power. The temple is nestled amid dense forests and scenic surroundings near the Girnar foothills, offering both spiritual peace and natural beauty.

The Bhavnath Fair - A Divine Festivity

The Bhavnath Fair is held every year during Maha Shivratri (February-March) and lasts for five days. The fair begins with a grand procession of naga sadhus (naked ascetics) riding elephants and chanting “Har Har Mahadev.” Devotees take a ritual bath in the holy Mrugi Kund before entering the temple to worship Lord Shiva.

At night, the temple comes alive with bhajans, devotional songs, and dances that continue until dawn. Stalls selling local handicrafts, sweets, and traditional ornaments create a festive atmosphere. It’s not just a fair - it’s a celebration of faith, culture, and divine energy.

Best Time to Visit

The best time to visit the temple is during Maha Shivratri, when the fair is in full swing. However, for those seeking peace and spiritual reflection, visiting between October and February offers a quieter experience.

Timings & Entry Fee

  • Temple Timings: 6:00 AM -9:00 PM
  • Entry Fee: Free

How to Reach

  • By Road: The temple is around 8 km from Junagadh city center. Auto-rickshaws and taxis are available easily.
  • By Train: The nearest railway station is Junagadh Junction, about 7 km away.
  • By Air: The nearest airport is Rajkot Airport, approximately 100 km from Junagadh.
